versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02095 If the updated signal (see [SWS_Com_00628]) has the ComTransferProperty TRIGGERED , then the function Com_SendDynSignal shall perform an immediate transmission (within the next main function at the latest) of the I-PDU associated with the signal except when the signal is packed into an I-PDU with PERIODIC transmission mode.
